respectively chose these answers in our representative online survey. The survey was conducted online among 2,018 respondents in Sweden, in 2025. Looking to gain valuable insights about customers of online shops across the globe? Check out [...] Read more

Description: The most common online purchase frequency in Sweden is once a month, according to a 2024 study. Nearly four out of ten shoppers bought items online monthly. A fifth of Swedish shoppers reported doing online shopping once per week, making it the
second most popular purchase frequency. Only seven percent of those surveyed reported that they make several purchases per week of products online. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; 2024; Around 1,000 respondents; 18-79 years
Source(s): PostNord

forecast_users.text:
Description: In 2024, U.S.-based Amazon was the favorite international online marketplace for roughly 32 percent of online shoppers in Sweden. The German e-commerce platform Zalando and China's Temu followed, as 30 percent and 28 percent of Swedish
respondents said they had shopped there during the past three months, respectively. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; March and April, 2024; approx. 1,000 respondents; 18-79 years
Source(s): PostNord

24 Description: A survey conducted in 2024 revealed the most purchased second-hand items online in Sweden. There was a high demand for second-hand fashion. Over half of Swedish consumers bought clothes and shoes when shopping for used products over the
internet. Online purchases of pre-owned furniture and home decor ranked second with 11 percent of respondents. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; March to April, 2024; 1,000 respondents; 18-79 years; based on consumers latest second-hand product purchase online
Source(s): PostNord

cross_border.text:
Description: According to a 2024 survey, China was the most popular foreign market for Swedish online shoppers. In 2024, around 37 percent of shoppers had ordered e-commerce purchases from China. This was an increase of around 17 percent compared to 2023
when China was only the third most popular cross-border market. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; 2023 and 2024; Around 1,000 respondents; 18-79 years
Source(s): PostNord

Description: According to a survey from 2024, around 29 percent of Swedish consumers purchase items from foreign online shops quarterly. Similarly, nearly a fourth of them did so monthly. Only five percent of the shoppers surveyed ordered items from
international webshops once per week. In 2024, Swedish consumers bought items cross-border mainly because of cheaper prices, interesting product assortments, and bigger product selections. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; March and April, 2024; 1,000 respondents; 18-79 years
Source(s): PostNord
